install: set -euo pipefail; touch "$HOME/.bashrc"; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true; NODE_VERSION="$(jq -r '.volta.node' package.json 2>/dev/null || node -p "require('./package.json').volta.node")"; PNPM_VERSION="$(jq -r '.volta.pnpm' package.json 2>/dev/null || node -p "require('./package.json').volta.pnpm")"; ARCH="$(uname -m)"; case "$ARCH" in x86_64) NODE_ARCH=x64 ;; aarch64|arm64) NODE_ARCH=arm64 ;; *) echo "Unsupported arch: $ARCH" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; NODE_DIR="$HOME/.local/node-v${NODE_VERSION}"; if [ ! -x "$NODE_DIR/bin/node" ] || [ "$("$NODE_DIR/bin/node" -v 2>/dev/null || true)" != "v${NODE_VERSION}" ]; then mkdir -p "$HOME/.local"; ( TMP_TAR="$(mktemp /tmp/node.XXXXXX.tar.xz)"; trap 'rm -f "$TMP_TAR"' EXIT; curl -fsSL "https://nodejs.org/dist/v${NODE_VERSION}/node-v${NODE_VERSION}-linux-${NODE_ARCH}.tar.xz" -o "$TMP_TAR"; rm -rf "$NODE_DIR"; mkdir -p "$NODE_DIR"; tar -xJf "$TMP_TAR" --strip-components=1 -C "$NODE_DIR" ); fi; ln -sfn "$NODE_DIR" "$HOME/.local/node"; mkdir -p "$HOME/.cache/mongodb-binaries"; grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/node/bin:$PATH"' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/node/bin:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; grep -qxF 'export MONGOMS_DOWNLOAD_DIR="$HOME/.cache/mongodb-binaries"' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export MONGOMS_DOWNLOAD_DIR="$HOME/.cache/mongodb-binaries"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; export PATH="$HOME/.local/node/bin:$PATH"; export MONGOMS_DOWNLOAD_DIR="$HOME/.cache/mongodb-binaries"; if [ ! -x "$HOME/.local/node/bin/pnpm" ] || [ "$("$HOME/.local/node/bin/pnpm" -v 2>/dev/null || true)" != "$PNPM_VERSION" ]; then npm install -g "pnpm@${PNPM_VERSION}" --no-fund --no-audit; fi; CI=true pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
